task.title: Make the rail's category fold button big enough to hit
task.description:
Follow-up from the review of "Unfold a category from the collapsed rail" (PR #170, 2026-10-10).

1. The category fold button in the collapsed rail (.category-toggle under :root.sidebar-collapsed, desktop/src/renderer/styles.css ~707-725) is about 15px tall: line-height 1 on a .72rem chevron plus .1rem padding, with .62rem initials. The control exists so the pointer can reach a folded category, and a target under 24px is below WCAG 2.5.8 AA and fiddly with a trackpad. Give it at least a 24x24 hit area (padding/min-height, or a larger transparent hit box) without making the divider read like a project key tile, and without shifting the rail's project tiles more than necessary. Check it visually in light and dark.

2. desktop/test/category-toggle.test.js's 'the rail does not hide the toggle' test matches only the exact selector string ':root.sidebar-collapsed .category-toggle'. Any other selector that hides the toggle in the rail passes, and folded categories become unreachable again with the suite green. Make the guard behavioral: resolve which rules apply to the toggle in the rail (or evaluate the stylesheet against a rail-mode element) and assert it is displayed and at least 24px tall, so it also guards item 1.
